title: Google G Construction
slide_intent: Refine a geometric symbol optically so it stays balanced and legible at small sizes.
strategic_value: A heavier compact G can retain Google’s identity when the full name cannot fit.
demonstration: A gridded circular construction becomes a multicolored G; guide lines and close views demonstrate its geometry and optical adjustments.
practical_value: Compare a small symbol’s apparent weight and joins with its geometric construction before accepting the grid as sufficient.

content_islands.name: Grid and circular skeleton
content_islands.spec: Begin with a centered square grid and circular G construction.

content_islands.name: Colored result
content_islands.spec: Reveal the four-color G in the same position, then compare its contour and crossbar relationships.

reference_purposes.Intent: The article explains increased visual weight for small contexts and optical correction at the circular form’s crossbar.
reference_purposes.Expression: The final G combines the familiar four colors into one compact form.
reference_purposes.Application: The construction sequence demonstrates the relationship between the grid, curves and final icon.

ingredient.name: Compact Google G
ingredient.role: Keep the brand identifiable where the full wordmark is too large.
ingredient.application: Use a visually heavier G derived from the wordmark, with an optically refined circular join and the demonstrated color order.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2015 icon construction; no numerical spacing rule is invented from the animation.
